note: Body copy on the page. The single most important pair on the site.
Body copy inside a code block or inset panel.
Body copy inside a callout, and a table row under the cursor.
Headings and the first cell of every table row.
Ledes and captions. Real prose despite the name -- it is the search-result text.
The same soft text where a callout or hovered row sits behind it.
Links. Colour is not the only signal (they are underlined) but they must still be read.
The Unlock button's label on its own fill.
The site title and header icons on the banner.
The [To be confirmed] pill and the gate label. WARN pending a measured run -- promote to fail once a build has printed a real number.
Dead-link markers and error text. WARN for the same reason as marker.

Input outlines and the table header rule. 3.0 is the WCAG floor for non-text UI. ⚠️ EVERY palette we ship currently fails this -- the hairline look trades it away deliberately. WARN so the shortfall stays visible instead of being deleted; see theme/README.md.
